name: Philips Hue
description: Control your Philips Hue bridge directly from widgets and wallpapers. List lights, rooms, scenes, sensors; toggle lights and groups; recall scenes; set colors via hex. Pure local-network plugin — no cloud, no OAuth, no client_secret. Pairing is a single physical button-press on the bridge.
author: iappyx
aiPrompt: iappyx.plugin('hue') talks directly to the user's Philips Hue Bridge over the LOCAL network (no cloud). Auth was a one-time button-press during pairing; the username is stored in secureStore. The plugin is network-restricted to the user's trusted Wi-Fi by default — calls return {ok:false, error:'plugin restricted to trusted Wi-Fi or VPN'} when off-network, which is correct because the bridge isn't reachable anyway. All methods return Promises; check {ok}. KEY METHODS — isConfigured() → {ok, configured, bridgeIp, bridgeName}. bridgeInfo() → {ok, name, modelid, swversion, mac, apiversion}. lights() → {ok, lights:[{id, name, on:bool, bri:1-254, hue:0-65535, sat:0-254, ct:153-500, xy:[x,y], colormode:'hs'|'xy'|'ct', reachable, type, model, manufacturer}]} — bri/hue/sat/ct are RAW Hue values; widget code converts to %/Kelvin if it wants user-facing units. groups() → {ok, groups:[{id, name, type:'Room'|'Zone'|'LightGroup'|'Entertainment', class:'Bedroom'|'Kitchen'|…, lights:[id], state:{any_on, all_on}, action:{on, bri, hue, sat, ct, xy, colormode, scene?}}]} — rooms and zones surface here. scenes({groupId?}) → {ok, scenes:[{id, name, group, lights:[id], owner, recycle, picture}]} — optionally filter to one group. sensors() → {ok, sensors:[{id, name, type:'ZLLPresence'|'ZLLTemperature'|'ZLLLightLevel'|'ZLLSwitch'|…, state, config, productname, manufacturername}]}. CONTROL — setLight({id, on?, bri?, hue?, sat?, ct?, hex?, transitiontime?}) PUTs one light's state. setGroup({id, ...}) PUTs an action across a whole group (PREFER this over per-light when controlling a room — one HTTP call, atomic). hex:'#FF6B35' is converted to xy automatically (sRGB→XYZ→xy 1931). transitiontime is in deciseconds (default 4 = 400ms fade). toggleGroup({id, transitiontime?}) reads any_on and PUTs the inverse — convenient for tap-to-toggle tiles. recallScene({id, groupId:'1'}) activates a saved scene; groupId optional but recommended (defaults to group 0 = all lights). All replies follow {ok:true, …} or {ok:false, error:'…'} — never throw. Best widgets: 'rooms grid' (one tile per group with brightness slider + on/off), 'scene picker' (3x3 grid of scene buttons tinted to their dominant color), 'motion log' (last 5 ZLLPresence trigger times). Best wallpapers: ambient brightness that scales with the average bri of `lights()` so the wallpaper matches the room's actual light level.
